core_claim.quote: In the attention schema theory, awareness is part of the control machinery for attention.

source.citation: Graziano MSA, Webb TW. The attention schema theory: a mechanistic account of subjective awareness. Frontiers in Psychology 6:500, 2015

prediction.statement: A controller of attention that has a simplified model of its own attention controls attention better than one without, even when the information about where attention is is available to it in other ways.

first_stated.passage: We propose that the top–down control of attention is improved when the brain has access to a simplified model of attention itself.

source.citation: Graziano MSA, Webb TW. The attention schema theory: a mechanistic account of subjective awareness. Frontiers in Psychology 6:500, 2015

prediction.test_for: Removing or disabling the model of attention, in a brain or an artificial agent, while leaving attention itself working and its location recoverable from the input, clearly worsens the control of attention and the learning of it.
prediction.test_against: Removing or disabling the model of attention leaves control of attention, and learning to control it, as good as before.
